title.narrative: A Comprehensive Response and Prevention to child protection challenges and Gender Based Violence in Elnino's awake in Kabasa, Qansaxleey, Ladan and Kaharey IDPs in Dollow, Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltpgtSEDHURO is committed to implementing a comprehensive Child Protection (CP) and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) integrated project within the Dollow District of Gedo region, which is characterized by a diverse and vulnerable population, including over 800,000 internally displaced persons (IDPs). The project, built upon our experience in this region and supported by UNICEF and UNFPA, is strategically designed to provide essential services to children, women, and other at-risk groups, with a particular focus on hard-to-reach areas. Our interventions encompass medical care, psychosocial support, and case management services. Additionally, we will distribute dignity kits to both adults and children, ensuring their basic needs are met, and establish safe spaces for those at-risk. The project prioritizes the best interest of children, striving to reunify unaccompanied and separated children with their biological parents or primary caregivers. For those awaiting reunification, foster care arrangements will provide a nurturing family environment. This initiative also seeks to strengthen community engagement in protection activities, notably through the establishment of accessible community protection desks, operated by trained personnel who can offer immediate assistance, referrals, and support to children and women in need.ltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtTarget Outcomes:lt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt1. Child Protection Component:lt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="mso-spacerun:yes"gt lt/spangt1.1.1: 300 unaccompanied and separated children will receive case management and psychosocial support services.lt/pgtltpgt 1.1.2: 150 unaccompanied and separated children will be successfully reunified with their biological parents and primary caregivers.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.1.3: 50 unaccompanied and separated children awaiting reunification will be placed under foster care arrangements.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.1.4: 200 vulnerable children of unaccompanied and separated children will receive emergency material assistance.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.1.5: Formation of community protection desks to serve as accessible community-based centers staffed by trained individuals, providing immediate assistance, referrals, and support for children and women facing protection challenges.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.1.6: 1150 children provided with community emergency PSS kitsltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.2.1: 4,860 children in Child-Friendly Spaces will receive basic and structured psychosocial support services, with activities disaggregated by gender.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 1.2.2: 70 school-age children will be referred to schools and learning spaces.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal"gt 2. GBV Component:lt/pgtltpgt 2.1.1: 320 women and girls subjected to GBV will receive comprehensive case management and psychosocial support/counseling through existing GBV One-Stop Centers (OSC) and women and girls safe space centers.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 2.1.2: 700 women and girls will receive culturally appropriate dignity kits approved by the dignity kits working group.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 2.1.3 150 women and girls will receive case management, psychosocial support, and engage in recreational activities in the women and girls safe space centers.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 2.1.4: 100 GBV survivors will receive cash assistance through mobile transfer.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 2.1.5: 30 SGBV survivors will receive medical and clinical management of rape (PEP KITS) at the GBV OSC.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt 2.1.6: Updating service mappings, development, and management of protection referral mechanisms and awareness raising on prevention and response to CP/GBV.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThis integrated project, capitalizing on our experience and the local context, is vital to provide essential protection and support to the diverse and vulnerable population residing in Dollow, Gedo region. With the looming El Niño, SEDHURO is poised to respond effectively and compassionately to the needs of these communities and IDPs, leveraging our strong network and partnerships in the area.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
